title: myriopus breviflorus
intro: Myriopus breviflorus, commonly known as Lophostemon suaveolens, is a species of plant in the family Myoporaceae. It is a small to medium-sized tree or shrub native to eastern Australia. The health benefits of Myriopus breviflorus include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be used to treat various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Myriopus breviflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
